run_cql_offline_rl: run a CQL offline RL agent on D4RL mujoco locomotion datasets using JAX
create_cql_learner: create a CQLLearner with Adam optimizers for policy and critic networks on demonstration data
build_cql_networks: build policy and critic networks from an environment spec using cql.make_networks
load_d4rl_dataset: load a D4RL dataset and create a JaxInMemoryRandomSampleIterator for batched random sampling
evaluate_cql_policy: evaluate a CQL policy using GenericActor and EnvironmentLoop over evaluation episodes
